facts.business: Jyot International Marketing Limited is a Non-Banking Financial Company (NBFC) focused on financial inclusion and providing affordable credit to customers in the lower half of the socio-economic pyramid.

auditor.name: M/s. Labadiya & Mehta
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Qualification: 1) Total interest income of Rs. 2,77,96,270 booked on Loans & Advances, but only Rs. 59,05,717 recovered during FY 2025-26. 2) Tax Deducted at Source amounting to Rs. 59,58,246 for FY 2025-26 not deposited. Emphasis of Matter: Income Tax Department issued Assessment Order for FY 2021-22 raising demand of Rs. 50,23,17,478; company filed appeal, no provision made.

key_risks: Low recovery of interest income on loans and advances (only ~21% recovered)
Non-deposit of TDS amounting to Rs. 59.58 lakh
Contingent tax liability of Rs. 502.32 crore for FY 2021-22 under appeal
Significant judgment required in ECL provisioning for loan impairment
